lots.title: Upper Deck Marvel Beginnings Spidey Villains 5-Card Lot: Goblin, Chameleon...
lots.theme_note: Classic Spider-Man rogues gallery (plus Arcade, the recurring villain-for-hire who frequently crosses over into Spidey/X-Men stories). Green Goblin is the recognizable anchor name.

lots.title: Upper Deck Marvel Beginnings X-Men Core 5-Card Lot: Professor X, Rogue...
lots.theme_note: Founder, headliner, and core mutant roster -- Professor X and Rogue are the recognizable names carrying this lot, with Jubilee/Husk/Callisto as fan-favorite X-Men supporting cast.

lots.title: Upper Deck Marvel Beginnings FF & Cosmic 4-Card Lot: Mr. Fantastic, Torch...
lots.theme_note: Fantastic Four leader + teammate, the cosmic Watcher who narrates their universe, and Inhuman royal Gorgon (a frequent FF-story crossover character). Only 4 cards -- no 5th FF-affinity character in this batch, so left as a 4-card lot rather than padding with an unrelated character. Note: the Human Torch card has a red foil border/background, likely a parallel version -- see flagged_parallels.

lots.title: Upper Deck Marvel Beginnings Samurai & X-Foes 5-Card Lot: Silver Samurai...
lots.theme_note: Wolverine's Japan saga (Silver Samurai, Mariko Yashida) plus katana-wielding Colleen Wing, and two X-Men/Wolverine-mythos deep cuts (Proteus, Cassandra Romulus). Silver Samurai is the recognizable anchor. Note: the Proteus card has a red foil/colored border, possibly a parallel -- see flagged_parallels.

lots.title: Upper Deck Marvel Beginnings Deep-Cut Villains 4-Card Lot: Ulik, Hood...
lots.theme_note: Obscure villains spanning Thor (Ulik), Captain America (Nightshade), Daredevil (Profile), and modern Avengers-era crime (The Hood). No single marquee name, so priced mid-range rather than top of band. Only 4 well-fitting villains in this batch -- kept as a 4-card lot.

lots.title: Upper Deck Marvel Beginnings Support Heroes 3-Card Lot: Stingray, Echo...
lots.theme_note: Leftover street-level/support heroes that didn't cleanly fit the other themes (Stingray - Avengers/Sub-Mariner ally; Echo - Daredevil/Avengers martial artist, has modern MCU/Disney+ visibility; Slingshot - Fantastic Force). Only 3 cards remained after other groupings, priced at the low end of the band accordingly.

flagged_parallels.note: Bright red/pink foil border and background, visually distinct from the plain white-bordered base design -- looks like a foil/fractal parallel rather than base. Human Torch is a recognizable name; if this is confirmed as a numbered or foil parallel, it's worth pulling as a standalone single rather than lotting it (Marvel Beginnings foil parallels of known characters often sell for several times base-common lot value).

Red foil/colored border around the card, distinct from the plain white-bordered base design -- likely the same parallel type as the Human Torch card above. Proteus is a much less recognizable name than Human Torch, so even if it's a confirmed parallel, standalone-single value is probably modest; recommend keeping it in the lot unless the parallel type turns out to be a limited/numbered insert.
